external_review.scope: Written methodological feedback, not experimental validation or partnership agreement

objective: Test whether frozen structural-confidence predictor generalizes to independent unpublished quantitative folding-stability data; no biological efficacy claim.

design.allocation_status: proposal, subject to custodian feasibility and blinded power review
design.independence: Independent benign model proteins; unrelated to training domains; independent laboratory or custodian documents provenance and screens overlap before freeze.
design.assay: One comparable quantitative stability assay and consistent conditions across cohort; laboratory attests protocol, units, sign, quality controls and any deviations before freeze; do not pool incompatible conditions.
design.diversity: Independent laboratory documents diversity and nonredundancy of naturally available benign research observations without using outcome values to select cases; no specific sequences or mutation designs proposed.
design.power: No guaranteed power at n=600. Pre-freeze independent review of domain-level clustering and plausible effects, report assumptions; if target infeasible, revise and register before predictions, never after labels.

frozen_model.source: parent frozen S2 predictor; no refitting or recalibration
frozen_model.provider_gate: Hold: T8A local delta pTM +0.0020025968551635742 versus Rowan -0.003; resolve comparability, model revision and source-specific MSA or separate preregistration with untouched independent holdout before scoring.

evaluation.primary_metric: Equal-domain-weighted MAE in kcal/mol with independently verified sign convention
evaluation.pass: All integrity gates pass; macro-MAE <= 0.90 times zero baseline; upper 95% confidence bound of paired macro-MAE difference < 0.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired domain-cluster bootstrap, 10000 replicates, deterministic seed 20261025; report domain coverage and missingness.
evaluation.secondary: Pooled MAE, per-domain rank and directional accuracy; descriptive, not substitutes for primary endpoint.
evaluation.missingness: Report all enrolled observations and failures; incomplete confirmatory cohort HOLD; no selective removal or post hoc rescue.
evaluation.negative_results: Publish fail/indeterminate; no tuning on this holdout.

custody.commitment: Independent custodian signs salted SHA-256 commitment to canonical ordered private outcomes plus provenance; high-entropy salt kept private until authorized unblinding.
release_order: Independent reviewer approves design, assay and sample-size analysis
Independent custodian confirms new unpublished outcomes and freezes input manifest and signed commitment
Resolve provider comparability gate; freeze model/code/configuration and all real predictions
Independent reviewer verifies time order, completeness, signature and integrity
Only then release and evaluate once
custody.public_data: Public FireProt/ThermoMPNN is retrospective only, never true prospective validation.

next_action: Seek independent academic laboratory/custodian with suitable existing unpublished benign protein stability cohort and ask for design review; no outcome disclosure or execution until gates pass.
